21:58: (caccabseeti) caccabaa isaan godhe. guddaa isaaniif ta’e malee (isa nihanbise) Akka isaan gara isaa (taabota guddichaa) deebi'aniif jecha.
21:59: (yeroo deebi'an ta mancaate argan) ni jedhan: “Namni gabbaramtoota keenyatti kana hojjate dhugumatti, inni miidhaa raawwattoota irraayi.”
21:60: Nijedhan “Dargaggeessa Ibraahiim isaan jedhamu (tokko) kan (hamtuun) isaan dubbatu dhageenyee jirra”.
21:61: Ni jedhan: “ijoowwan namootaa dura isa fidaa, Akka isaan ragaa (irratti) bahaniif jecha.”
21:62: (ummatarra fidaniiti) “Sila situ gabbaramtoota keenya irratti (caccabsaa) kana raawwatee Yaa Ibraahiim?” jedhan.
21:63: (Ibraahiim) “Lakkii, guddaa isaaniitu kana hojjate, Yoo kan dubbatan ta’aniif isaan gaafadhaa” jedhe.
21:64: Gara lubbuulee isaanii deebi’anii (ufitti qaanfatanii) “isin isinumatu miidhaa raawwattoota (Rabbii gaditti isii gabbaruu keessaniif)” jedhan.
21:65: Eegasii mataalee isaanii lafatti gadi qabatanii “ati dhugumatti, isaan kun hin dubbatanuu beektee jirta (maaliif gaafadhaa nuun jetta?)” jedhaniin.
21:66: (Ibraahiim) ni jedhe: “Sila Rabbii achitti waan homaa isin hin fayyadneefi isin hin miine gabbartanii?
21:67: Isiniifi wantoota isin Allaah malee gabbartaniinis ‘uffi’ (jedheera)! Sila hin xiinxaltanii?”
21:68: Ni jedhan: “ isa (ibraahiim ibiddaan) gubaa; gabbaramtoota keessaniif tumsaa. Yoo kan hojjattan taataniif”
21:69: Nijenne “Yaa ibiddaa! Ibraahiim irratti qabbanaafi nagaa tahi".
21:70: (isa gubuuf) shira isatti fedhan, (nagaya isa baafne) irra hoongawoota isaan goone.
21:71: Isaafi Luuxiin gara dachii ishee keessa aalama hundaaf barakaa gooneetti (shaamitti) nagaya baafne.
21:72: (yeroo inni ilmoo Rabbi kadhate isaaf awwaannee) Is'haaqiin isaaf (ibraahimiif) kenninee, Ya’aquub (ilma ishaaq)is dabalataan (isaaf kennine) Hundaayyuu gaggaarii goone.
